title: CrypTorch: Unified PyTorch-based Auto-tuning Compiler for Private Machine Learning Inference
abstract: arXiv:2511.19711v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: MPC-based ML uses secure multi-party computation (MPC) to execute machine learning (ML) workloads across multiple parties without requiring any party to reveal its private data or model parameters. Our characterization study finds that the performance of state-of-the-art MPC frameworks is often dominated by operator-approximation strategies, where ML operators not natively supported by MPC are replaced with iterative methods or polynomials. These approximations are typically chosen heuristically by each framework and applied globally. As a result, they can be unnecessarily expensive in some cases, yet insufficiently accurate in others. We find that the best approximation choice depends on the context, target framework, and application, making a single globally fixed approximation fundamentally suboptimal. To address this problem, we design CrypTorch, a multi-stage compiler for MPC-based ML that supports multiple MPC frameworks

translated_title: CrypTorch：面向隐私机器学习推理的基于PyTorch的统一自动调优编译器
translated_abstract: 基于MPC的机器学习利用安全多方计算（MPC）在多个参与方之间执行机器学习（ML）工作负载，而无需任何一方公开其私有数据或模型参数。我们的特征分析研究发现，最先进的MPC框架的性能往往由算子近似策略主导，即MPC本身不原生支持的ML算子会被迭代方法或多项式所替代。这些近似通常由各框架以启发式方式选择并全局应用。因此，它们在某些情况下可能代价过高，而在另一些情况下又精度不足。我们发现最佳的近似选择取决于具体上下文、目标框架和应用场景，这使得单一的全局固定近似从根本上说是次优的。为解决这一问题，我们设计了CrypTorch，一个支持多种MPC框架的面向基于MPC的机器学习的多阶段编译器。
tldr: CrypTorch是一个基于PyTorch的多阶段编译器，能够根据上下文、目标框架和应用场景自动调优算子近似策略，解决了MPC机器学习框架中全局固定近似策略从根本上次优的问题。
en_tdlr: CrypTorch is a unified PyTorch-based multi-stage compiler that auto-tunes operator approximation strategies according to context, target framework, and application, addressing the fundamental suboptimality of globally fixed approximations in MPC-based machine learning inference.
